title: Opening: location, date and Cage's name
summary: The interviewer establishes they are at Cage's house in Zachary on May 13, 1967; Cage gives his name as James Cage, called Butch.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Let's see. We're now at Butch Cage's house, huh? Where we at exactly? Zachary, yeah. Zachary, Lewis, yeah. And the number here is? 5131 Old Slaughter Road. 5131 Old Slaughter Road. And what's today's date? It's May the... 13th. 13th. 13th. 13th? May the 13th, 1967. What is your name anyhow? James Cage. And what do they call you? Butch.
How come they call you Butch anyhow? I don't know. Mama called me that nickname.
Nickname. Nickname. They've been calling you that since you were a little boy? Yes, sir. I see. I can hear myself talk. Oh, that's terrible. It sounds awful.
I don't want them either. I'm so tall.
